title: fix(runtime): include the production Memories intent adapter
body:
Ordinary DomainService publishing omitted the owner intent adapter, and catalog registration scanned only its declaration assembly. Include the adapter in the normal owner project graph and pass its actual factory assembly to SDK catalog registration.

Enroll DomainService.Tests in the Docker-free unit/contract inventory and strict coverage contract. Require its report and exact production assembly source scope while preserving the original seven projects, fourteen assembly scopes, 76.5% threshold, trait exclusions and TRX/Cobertura requirements. Regression controls connect coverage requirements to the executable inventory and preserve inherited MTP coverage. Contributor docs describe the same eight-project lane.

Release output consumes genuine public SDK 4.1.0 packages; preparation selects genuine Builds 4.44.4. Existing compatibility profiles and publication authorities remain intact.

Validation: final-head [CI42129498003](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Memories/actions/runs/42129498003) passes all required jobs. Actual artifacts contain 5,415 unit passes, including all 13 DomainService cases and real factory discovery; coverage is 34,630/42,472 lines (81.54%) against 76.5%. Fast integration passes 484 cases, shared Release Contracts599, source catalog3 and browser JUnit5. The one unit and nine integration unexecuted cases are existing. All 40 coverage/validator/runner fixtures run in hosted CI. Local causal failures, real signed SDK/output checks and strict missing-eighth/unknown-ninth/source-scope controls remain retained. Normal protected publication is the next prerequisite; this PR alone grants no final native or Story acceptance.
